objective: server/services/russell/negation.ts NEGATORS matches only the ASCII apostrophe (don'?t, doesn'?t, didn'?t ...). Phones type U+2019, so NEGATORS.test('Don’t fix the footer') is false and a software request like 'Don’t change Brain, fix V4' reads the exclusion as a mention (CLAUDE.md §27). Fix: accept ['’]? in every apostrophe position (and add can't / won't forms), and export a small foldApostrophes helper.
expectedOutcome: Negation is detected whichever apostrophe the person typed.
nonGoals: Changing which words count as negators beyond the apostrophe forms

acceptanceConditions.statement: curly-apostrophe negators are detected exactly like ASCII ones, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
